verdict.rationale: Xero offers a documented public API with an official OpenAPI spec, SDKs, and an MCP server covering contacts, chart of accounts, and invoices. That gives programmatic access through which data could be pulled out, but the evidence never describes a first-party full-data export or offboarding path; the only export shown is a bank payment file, and the migration evidence covers moving into Xero, not out. Missing for 10: a documented complete data export, named open export formats (CSV/JSON etc.) covering all records, offboarding or account-closure guidance, and independent confirmation that a full export works in practice.
